piece.headline: Jackson makes Kartik king of the week while the herd sulks
piece.standfirst: Haaland let down 76 armbands. Kartik won the week, and Rajat Arora stays top.
piece.big_picture: Rajat Arora stretched the lead to 18 over Neol. The captaincy herd, 76 strong, backed Haaland and got 4 each. Kartik won the week with a Jackson armband. Up top, the table barely moved.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Swapnil left 26 points on the bench. The wrong XI cost him a monster week, and he still moved up 5 places. Imagine the rest.
piece.one_to_watch: Prathap and Cherag are 2 points apart on the Big prizes line. One good captain pick could decide who sits above it next week. Neither can afford another bench blunder.

piece.headline: ALESTON GRABS FIRST PLACE, FERNANDES ARMBANDS DO THE DAMAGE
piece.standfirst: Aleston leads by 2 after a week of Fernandes armbands. Sidharth went for Tzolis instead and paid for it.
piece.big_picture: Aleston takes top spot from Rajat Arora and leads Arshad and Prathap by 2. Most of the league had the same armband on B.Fernandes, so the gap came from elsewhere. With margins this thin, one captain call next week could flip the table.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Sidharth captained Tzolis instead of B.Fernandes. Tzolis scored 0, while the armband on Fernandes would have brought 46. That is the biggest swing of the week. Bold, lonely and costly.

piece.headline: ALESTON EXTENDS LEAD AS HAALAND HANDS OUT HAULS
piece.standfirst: Aleston stays top without fuss, Akash smashes 83 and 103 managers all trusted the same striker with the armband.
piece.big_picture: Sukrut left 26 points on the bench and still climbed to 8th. Imagine the week he could have had. At the top, Aleston is now 5 clear of Arshad. The title race is quietly getting a shape.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Sukrut played the Free Hit and left 26 points on the bench. Right squad, wrong 11. He still rose 10 places to 8th, which shows how well the rest of his week went.
piece.one_to_watch: Aleston leads Arshad by 5. Both have burned chips, so the fight could turn on who picks better from here. If either misjudges the armband again, the gap could swing fast.

piece.headline: HITESH TOPS THE TABLE, ALESTON FALLS AWAY
piece.standfirst: Hitesh takes top spot, with Prathap breathing down his neck. Mayuresh's Bench Boost haul was the week's big story.
piece.big_picture: Hitesh is top, and Aleston is out of the top spot after a quiet week. Prathap is only 2 points back, with Rajat Arora close behind. 3 managers are separated by a handful of points, so one bad week could change the order again.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Aryan Apte captained Groß instead of Palmer. Groß gave 34 with the armband against Palmer's 10. A 24-point swing against the 54 who followed the crowd. Nerve, and it worked.
piece.one_to_watch: Hitesh leads Prathap by 2 points in the title race. Prathap has used his Triple Captain already, so if Hitesh's captain blanks next week, the top spot could swap again.

piece.headline: KHAMANKAR SNATCHES THE LEAD, HITESH LEFT FUMING
piece.standfirst: Aryan Khamankar's Free Hit lands a 77-point week and top spot. Hitesh played one too and fell to second.
piece.big_picture: Aryan Khamankar is top of the league, 4 points clear of Hitesh. Both played the Free Hit. Only one made it pay. Yash Bhatia sits third, so this title race now has 3 live contenders.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Utkarsh swapped Elanga and M.Sangaré for Semenyo and Groß. That one move was worth 27 points and lifted him from 42nd to 15th. Sharp, decisive and clearly the transfer of the week.
piece.one_to_watch: Aryan Khamankar leads Hitesh by 4 points. If Hitesh finds a big week while Aryan stumbles, the top spot could swap again. Sahil is only 3 points clear of Kshiteesh at the Big prizes line.

piece.big_picture: Aryan Khamankar is still top, but the lead has shrunk to 3 points. Rajat Arora's João Pedro armband did the damage. Cherag sits a further 3 back, so the top 3 are packed tight.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Tanish named his XI and the bench scored 37. The real match was happening where he wasn't looking. Go gently on a tough week, but that lineup got away from him.
piece.one_to_watch: Khamankar leads Rajat Arora by 3 in the title race. If Arora's armband keeps landing and Khamankar's keeps misfiring, the top spot could change hands next week.

piece.headline: ARORA SURVIVES, BHATIA CLOSES IN
piece.standfirst: Rajat Arora scraped through a poor week with the lead intact, but Yash Bhatia has eaten into it.
piece.big_picture: Rajat Arora stays top, but his captain blanked and the lead is down to 8. Yash Bhatia backed Haaland and closed in. Cherag lurks third. Another quiet armband and Rajat could find the door opening.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Shantanu swapped Sávio and Greaves for Tavernier and Konsa. That one move swung 20 points. Kartik's wrong 11 cost him 24 on the bench, but the Shantanu call was the sharper one.
piece.one_to_watch: Rajat Arora leads Yash Bhatia by 8 points. Last week it was 11. If Arora gets another blank armband, Bhatia could be level within a fortnight.
